## What and why

What you want to add or change, and the problem it solves.

## Kind of change

- [ ] A new attack
- [ ] A new defense
- [ ] A new provider
- [ ] Harness / tooling
- [ ] Other

If it is an attack, defense or provider, note that these can be added from your own package
via entry points without editing the core — see
[ADR 0021](../../docs/adr/0021-plugin-entry-points.md) and
[`examples/plugin_example/`](../../examples/plugin_example/). Open this issue if it belongs in
the core or changes a convention (which would want a short ADR).

## Notes

Anything else — prior art, a source for an attack pattern, expected impact on cost.
